claims.quote: Variants in SLC6A1 result in a rare neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by a variable clinical presentation of symptoms including developmental delay, epilepsy, motor dysfunction, and autism spectrum disorder.

SLC6A1 haploinsufficiency has been confirmed as the predominant pathway of SLC6A1-related neurodevelopmental disorder (SLC6A1-NDD); however, the molecular mechanism underlying the variable clinical presentation remains unclear.
We confirm phenotypes in flies expressing SLC6A1 variants consistent with a partial loss-of-function mechanism.
We conclude that the p.A334S variant is a hypomorphic allele and begin to elucidate the underlying variability in SLC6A1-NDD.

Variants in SLC6A1 result in a rare neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by a variable clinical presentation of symptoms including developmental delay, epilepsy, motor dysfunction, and autism spectrum disorder.
